guards.what: Enchant's stacking branch (CardCmd.cs:545-549) is unreachable from here
guards.maps_to: the sim's base can_enchant is a flat `card.enchantment is None` (enchantments.py:57), where EnchantmentModel.CanEnchant lets a SECOND copy of the same enchantment through when IsStackable is true (EnchantmentModel.cs:289-292), and CardCmd.Enchant then does `Amount += amount`. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/event_probes.py enchantstack`): EnchantmentModel.IsStackable (EnchantmentModel.cs:173) defaults false and has ZERO overrides among enchantments in the whole game source -- the five IsStackable overrides that exist are all Afflictions or Relics. So the sim's flat check is exactly the source's behaviour and the stacking branch is dead code on both sides. Recorded here rather than asserted, per rule 5. Applies identically at the other four enchant sites in this batch (self_help_book, spiraling_whirlpool, stone_of_all_time, symbiote).
